## Run summary

```{r index-methods, results='asis'}
is_deg_table <- identical(params$run_args$analysis_mode, "deg_table") ||
  identical(params$diffexp_out$source, "deg_table")
if (!is.null(params$repro)) {
  saved <- any(grepl("readRDS(", params$repro$code, fixed = TRUE))
  cat("\n\nThe R script below reruns this analysis with the same input and ",
      "settings",
      if (saved) " (the input is saved beside it in `reproduce/inputs.rds`)" else "",
      ". Run it from the folder that holds this page.\n\n", sep = "")
  DEGreports::emit_widget(
    DEGreports::link_output_file(params$repro$href,
                                    label = "Download R script")
  )
  DEGreports::emit_code_block(params$repro$code)
} else if (is_deg_table) {
  DEGreports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce this report from a merged DEG table:",
    "library(DEGreports)",
    "out <- run_deg(",
    "  deg_table = \"all_contrasts_deg.csv\",",
    "  collections = c(\"HALLMARK\", \"GOBP\"),",
    "  save_dir = \"results\"",
    ")"
  )
} else {
  DEGreports::emit_code_block(
    caption = "Reproduce this report with the package entry point:",
    "library(DEGreports)",
    "out <- run_deseq2(",
    "  dds, var = \"condition\",",
    "  run_gsva = TRUE, run_wgcna = TRUE, run_decoupler_tf = TRUE,",
    "  run_decoupler_ccc = TRUE, run_viper = TRUE,",
    "  save_dir = \"results\"",
    ")"
  )
}
```

```{r summary-table}
vdj_label <- if (!is.null(params$qc_out$remove_vdj) && length(params$qc_out$remove_vdj)) {
  paste(params$qc_out$remove_vdj, collapse = "+")
} else if (!is.null(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !is.null(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !isFALSE(params$run_args$remove_vdj) &&
           !(is.character(params$run_args$remove_vdj) && !length(params$run_args$remove_vdj))) {
  paste(as.character(params$run_args$remove_vdj), collapse = "+")
} else {
  "none"
}

is_deg_table <- identical(params$run_args$analysis_mode, "deg_table") ||
  identical(params$diffexp_out$source, "deg_table")
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Grouping variable", "Design formula", "Organism",
            "Samples",
            if (is_deg_table) "Genes (in DEG table)" else "Genes (post-QC)",
            "Significance threshold (alpha)", "LFC threshold", "VDJ gene removal",
            "DEGreports version"),
  Value = c(paste(params$var, collapse = ", "), params$design_str, params$org,
            if (is_deg_table) "n/a (DEG table)" else as.character(params$n_samples),
            as.character(params$n_genes),
            as.character(params$alpha), as.character(params$lfc_threshold),
            if (is_deg_table) "n/a" else vdj_label,
            as.character(params$package_version))
)
knitr::kable(summary_df)
```

```{r contrast-inventory, results='asis'}
manifest <- params$diffexp_out$manifest
specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
if (!is.null(manifest) && nrow(manifest) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n## Contrasts\n\n")
  cat(nrow(manifest), " contrast(s) in this run, with the question each asks ",
      "and the number of samples its model was fitted on. Full detail ",
      "(design formula, coefficients) is in `deseq2/contrasts.csv` and on the ",
      "DESeq2 page.\n\n", sep = "")
  inv <- manifest[, intersect(c("label", "question", "n_samples"),
                              colnames(manifest)), drop = FALSE]
  names(inv) <- c("Contrast", "Question", "n")[seq_len(ncol(inv))]
  print(knitr::kable(inv, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
} else if (!is.null(specs) && nrow(specs) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n## Contrasts\n\n")
  cat(nrow(specs), " contrast(s) in this run:\n\n", sep = "")
  inv <- specs[, intersect(c("label", "class", "type", "stratum_level", "comparison"),
                           colnames(specs)), drop = FALSE]
  print(knitr::kable(inv, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r run-args, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$run_args) && length(params$run_args)) {
  cat("\n\n## Pipeline arguments\n\n")
  entry <- if (identical(params$run_args$analysis_mode, "deg_table") ||
               identical(params$diffexp_out$source, "deg_table")) {
    "`run_deg()`"
  } else if (identical(params$run_args$analysis_mode, "lrt")) {
    "`run_deseq2(mode = 'lrt')`"
  } else if (identical(params$run_args$analysis_mode, "limma")) {
    "`run_limma()`"
  } else {
    "`run_deseq2()`"
  }
  cat("Arguments passed to ", entry, " for this run:\n\n", sep = "")
  args <- params$run_args
  fmt <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return("NULL")
    if (is.logical(x) && length(x) == 1) return(as.character(x))
    if (is.numeric(x) && length(x) == 1) return(as.character(x))
    if (is.character(x)) return(paste(x, collapse = ", "))
    paste(deparse(x), collapse = " ")
  }
  args_df <- data.frame(
    Argument = names(args),
    Value = vapply(args, fmt, character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print(knitr::kable(args_df, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Report sections

```{r section-links, results='asis'}
hrefs <- params$page_hrefs
if (is.null(hrefs)) hrefs <- DEGreports::report_page_hrefs(params$current_page)
cat("\n\nThis report is split across the following linked pages (each module's HTML ",
    "lives in its own folder, alongside the figures and downloads it links to, ",
    "and is viewable offline):\n\n", sep = "")
cat("\n\n- [**QC**](", hrefs[["QC"]], ") -- sample QC, library QC, PCA, and sample-similarity heatmap\n", sep = "")
cat("- [**DESeq2**](", hrefs[["DESeq2"]],
    ") -- per-comparison MA plot, volcano plot, DEG table",
    if (!is.null(params$ppi_out)) ", and PPI connectivity" else "",
    "\n", sep = "")
cat("- [**clusterProfiler**](", hrefs[["clusterProfiler"]],
    ") -- per-comparison, per-collection GSEA barplot, gene-enrichment barcode, and results table",
    if (!is.null(params$gsea_overlap_out)) {
      ", plus leading-edge Jaccard overlap (binary-cut clusters + word clouds)"
    } else {
      ""
    },
    "\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(params$wgcna_out)) {
  cat("- [**WGCNA**](", hrefs[["WGCNA"]],
      ") -- co-expression modules, module-trait/eigengene heatmaps, per-module pathway enrichment",
      if (!is.null(params$ppi_out) && length(params$ppi_out$by_module)) {
        ", and module PPI connectivity"
      } else {
        ""
      },
      "\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- WGCNA -- not run for this report (`wgcna_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$gsva_out)) {
  cat("- [**GSVA**](", hrefs[["GSVA"]],
      ") -- sample-level gene-set variation analysis (HALLMARK always; large collections heatmapped by group association)\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- GSVA -- not run for this report (`gsva_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$decoupler_tf_out)) {
  cat("- [**decoupleR-TF**](", hrefs[["decoupleR-TF"]],
      ") -- CollecTRI network + ULM transcription-factor activities\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- decoupleR-TF -- not run for this report (`decoupler_tf_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out)) {
  cat("- [**decoupleR-CCC**](", hrefs[["decoupleR-CCC"]],
      ") -- LIANA / OmniPath ligand–receptor pairs + ULM (per comparison)\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- decoupleR-CCC -- not run for this report (`decoupler_ccc_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$viper_out)) {
  cat("- [**VIPER**](", hrefs[["VIPER"]],
      ") -- bcellViper regulon + VIPER / msVIPER protein-activity inference\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- VIPER -- not run for this report (`viper_out = NULL`)\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$multihit_out)) {
  cat("- [**Multihit**](", hrefs[["Multihit"]],
      ") -- cross-analysis gene ranking (DEG / GSEA / VIPER / decoupleR-TF / decoupleR-CCC / CSPA)\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- Multihit -- not run for this report (`multihit_out = NULL`)\n")
}
cat("\n\n")
```
